state:
Goal `core-xml-node-and-1-more`: 2 of 3 members have their feature proofs on disk.
`Core\Xml\Node::attributes` and `Core\Xml\Node::children` are done. `children` has about.md,
three examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded figure, two `.nvst` cases carrying its
`covers:` marker, a Rust test, and a plain card.
The children attack found a bug, now fixed: `Core\Xml::parse` built its Rust tree without asking
the budget, so a 40 MB document of `<i/>` reached 3.8 GB against a 256 MB cap. The parse now
asks once per node and per attribute (`Reader::afford`), and a breach is the limit's `FATAL`.
`a_parse_stops_at_the_memory_limit_while_it_builds_the_tree` pins it.
Every Xml bench is re-measured against the changed `xml.rs`.
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/lib.rs` has an uncommitted change that is not this goal's (the `granting`
test helper canonicalizes grants). Leave it alone.

The two `.nvst` cases that now cover `children` also call `->kind()` and need only a `// covers:` line. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`

backlog: `Core\Xml\Reader::read` and `::depth` owe every proof, and the class owes its card: `READ_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:582`, `DEPTH_DOC` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:602`, and the class's row in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5283`.
